findings.title: Concurrent-delete NPE not fixed in sibling methods
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() was made null-safe via modelSupplier.get() null-check, but getSubGroupsStream(search,first,max) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(first,max) at line 260, and getSubGroupsStream(search,exact,first,max) at line 268 still unconditionally dereference modelSupplier.get(). If the group is deleted concurrently the supplier returns null and these methods still throw NullPointerException, so the fix is incomplete for the same race.

findings.title: Reader thread never joined, assertion races
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a raw new Thread that loops until deletedAll is set, but never stores the Thread, never joins it, and asserts caughtExceptions immediately after deletedAll.set(true). An exception added by the reader after the assertion is missed, and the still-running thread leaks into subsequent tests and can use a closed admin client/session. The test must join the thread (with timeout) before asserting.
